investigation_notes.User Lookup Result: No users found for emails: acc_svc@globalcorp.ee (likely service/integration account)
investigation_notes.Description: An automated-looking service account (acc_svc@globalcorp.ee) using a WinHttp user-agent performed 294 SharePoint downloads from the DACH finance site, which is a large deviation from the 24-hour baseline of 25. The accessed files include payroll, bank statements, and other sensitive financial records, and although the activity occurred at ~17:10 local time, the combination of automated access patterns, service-account naming, and high-volume access to sensitive finance data increases risk. No user record or prior related events were found, so this activity warrants escalation for further investigation.
